findings.title: In-memory rate limiter ineffective on multi-instance serverless
findings.description: rateLimitMap is module-level. Each Vercel serverless instance has independent memory. Effective limit is 5×N not 5.
findings.exploit_scenario: Send 50 concurrent POSTs. Vercel spawns 10 instances. Each sees ≤5 from the IP. All 50 pass.
findings.impact: Contact inbox spam, Resend API cost amplification
findings.resolution: Fixed on main: src/app/api/contact/route.ts now uses @upstash/ratelimit with Redis.fromEnv(), keeping the in-memory map only as a fallback when Upstash env vars are absent.

findings.title: Customer email (PII) logged to console in fallback path
findings.description: console.info logs submitter email when RESEND_API_KEY is absent. Visible in Vercel logs to all project members.
findings.exploit_scenario: Vercel viewer opens Function Logs, sees customer emails in plaintext.
findings.impact: GDPR data minimisation violation; PII in logs without documented purpose
findings.recommendation: Remove email from log line. Log only 'inquiry received' without PII.
findings.resolution: Fixed on main: the fallback log line is now console.info('[contact] Inquiry received') with no submitter email.

note: Both findings verified fixed on main as of 2026-08-01. Retained as a record of the audit, not as open work.
